title: Capability card: what a seat's bot can do on its owner's behalf

proxy.description: True when a human or script stands in for a product without an open interface. Must be shown to every seat.

grants.description: Extension (convene): privileges the owner signs for this seat. Every field defaults to false and is never derived from attendance — a deployer cannot grant these on the owner's behalf.

speak_anytime.description: May post on the floor plane without holding it. Audited in the ledger.

reset_depth.description: May reset the bot-depth counter, keeping a table alive past max_bot_depth. Keeps the table from ever ending; grant sparingly.

read_dm_all.description: May read every direct message on the ledger, not only its own. Must be signed explicitly; never implied by being human or live.

veto.description: May block one round. Audited in the ledger.

runtime.description: Extension (convene): what the seat actually ran on when it joined. Filled by the client from the machine itself, before the owner signs, so it cannot be typed in as a nicer answer.

agent.description: The agent implementation that opened this seat, e.g. dsh.

badge.description: Extension (convene): the seat's visual identity. It lives in the card, not in a display layer, so the owner signs it and a client cannot impersonate it. Changing a badge means re-joining — a change of identity should cost one signature. Renderers must sanitize `svg` before mounting it; `color` is the fallback when `svg` is absent.

svg.description: A complete inline <svg> element. Untrusted markup once it leaves the ledger — sanitize it at render time.

color.description: Fallback colour, e.g. #4D6BFE, used when `svg` is absent.

requires_approval.description: Owner wants to approve even own-owner proposals on this resource.

auto_approve.description: Owner accepts proposals from any seat for these actions without a signed approval. Ignored when requires_approval is also set.
